title: Flat-unit compatibility on raw section classes
statement: Let g : S' → S be a flat scheme morphism, K any nonnegative cochain complex of O_S-modules, p a natural number, and V an open of S. Put A = tensorPullback g, B = pushforward g, and let eta : K → B(AK) be the degreewise unit of their chosen adjunction. Let r_K,V : H^p(K(V)) → H^p(K)(V) denote the evaluation homology comparison followed by theta, as in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Then r_K,V followed by the section component of the adjoint of the inverse exact A-homology comparison equals H^p(eta(V)) followed by r_AK,g^-1(V). No target complex or cochain map out of AK occurs in this identity.

proof.text: Represent a raw section-complex homology class on V by a cycle. Its image under the termwise unit is a cycle on g inverse V by naturality for the differential. Naturality for the cycle inclusion identifies this with the image under the unit on the cycle sheaf.

Exactness of A identifies its image of the cycle sheaf with the cycle sheaf of AK and its image of the homology quotient with the quotient for AK. Naturality of the unit for the quotient identifies the image of the source cycle class with the target cycle class under the inverse comparison.

The map theta is the sheafification unit on cycle classes, with the exact homology comparison for sheafification followed by the counit. On cycles its composite with the homology quotient equals the quotient into the homology sheaf. Apply exact evaluation to this identity on source and target. The two unit images from the preceding steps agree on all cycles, and the raw homology quotient is epimorphic, proving equality of morphisms. No inverse for theta is required, and the same calculation covers p=0 and empty opens.

theorem flatUnit_raw_sections {S S' : Scheme.{uBC}} (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat g]
    (K : CochainComplex S.Modules ℕ) (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) :
    let A := (tensorPullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let U := SheafOfModules.forget S.ringCatSheaf
    let U' := SheafOfModules.forget S'.ringCatSheaf
    let E := PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf S.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation S.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj (op V)
    let E' := PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf S'.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation S'.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    let adj := Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)
    ((((U.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K).sc p).mapHomologyIso E).hom ≫
        E.map (sectionCohomologyTheta K p) ≫
        Hom.app (adj.homEquiv _ _ ((K.sc p).mapHomologyIso (tensorPullback g)).inv) V =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (((RingedSpace.openModuleSections S.toRingedSpace V).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).unit.app K)) p ≫
        ((((U'.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (A.obj K)).sc p)
          |>.mapHomologyIso E').hom ≫ E'.map (sectionCohomologyTheta (A.obj K) p)
